# load data

```{julia}
log = load_log(run_path)
config = load_config(joinpath(run_path, "config.json"))
mapping = load_task_index_mapping(run_path)
```

```{julia}
a1 = 1
a2 = 2
a3 = 5
log1 = filter(row -> row.bee1_id ==a1, log)
log2 = filter(row -> row.bee1_id ==a2, log)
log3 = filter(row -> row.bee1_id ==a3, log)
task_index(s::AbstractString) = parse(Int, match(r"task_(\d+)", s).captures[1])
task_label(s::AbstractString) = latexstring("\\text{Task }", task_index(s))
```

```{julia}
dfig = Figure()
deg2rad(θ) = θ * (pi/180)
az = deg2rad(12)
el = 0.13 * pi
labelsize = 20
ticklabelsize = 18
#task_cols = names(log_last, r"^task_")
ax = Axis3(dfig[1,1], 
                xlabel=task_label(mapping[1]), 
                ylabel=task_label(mapping[2]), 
                zlabel=task_label(mapping[3]),
                azimuth=az*pi,
                elevation = el)
lines!(ax, log1.task_1, log1.task_2, log1.task_3, linewidth=4, color=(:red, 0.85), label=latexstring("\\text{Agent }", a1))
lines!(ax, log2.task_1, log2.task_2, log2.task_3, linewidth=4, color=(:blue, 0.85), label=latexstring("\\text{Agent }", a2))
lines!(ax, log3.task_1, log3.task_2, log3.task_3, linewidth=4, color=(:green, 0.85), label=latexstring("\\text{Agent }", a3))
ax.xgridcolor = (:gray, 0.3)
ax.ygridcolor = (:gray, 0.3)
ax.zgridcolor = (:gray, 0.3)
ax.xlabelsize = labelsize
ax.ylabelsize = labelsize
ax.zlabelsize = labelsize
ax.xticklabelsize = ticklabelsize
ax.yticklabelsize = ticklabelsize
ax.zticklabelsize = ticklabelsize
ax.xticks = ([0, 0.5, 1.0], [L"0", L"0.5", L"1"])
ax.yticks = ([0, 0.5, 1.0], [L"0", L"0.5", L"1"])
ax.zticks = ([0, 0.5, 1.0], [L"0", L"0.5", L"1"])
#ax.aspect = :data
axislegend(ax, 
    position = :lt,
    labelsize = ticklabelsize,
    framevisible = false)
```
